chunks: Aḥmad ibn Mihrān, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī, from ʿAbdullāh al-Qallāʾ, from al-Fayḍ ibn al-Mukhtār, who said:

I said to Abī ʿAbdillāh (عليه السلام), 'Take my hand out of the Fire; who is for us after you?' Then Abū Ibrāhīm (عليه السلام) entered before him, and at that time he was a boy. So he said: 'This is your master, so hold fast to him.'

key_terms.أَبُو إِبْرَاهِيمَ: Abū Ibrāhīm, the kunyah of Imam Mūsā al-Kāẓim (عليه السلام)
key_terms.النَّارِ: the Fire, meaning punishment from which salvation is sought
key_terms.صَاحِبُكُمْ: your master or leader, referring to the one to be followed
key_terms.غُلَامٌ: a young boy, indicating his youth at the time
key_terms.فَتَمَسَّكْ: hold fast, meaning adhere firmly and remain attached

ai.seo_question: Who did Abū ʿAbdillāh al-Ṣādiq (عليه السلام) designate after him according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith records a clear designation of Abū Ibrāhīm Mūsā (عليه السلام) as the authority after Abī ʿAbdillāh (عليه السلام). It presents adherence to the Imam (عليه السلام) as a means of salvation from the Fire and guidance for the community after the previous Imam (عليه السلام).

en.hubeali: Ahmad Bin Mihran, from Muhammad Bin Ali, from Abdullah Al Qala’a, from Al Fayz Bin Al Mkhtar who said,

‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘Take my hand out from the fire, who would be for us after you<sup>asws</sup>?’ So Abu Ibrahim<sup>asws</sup> (7<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) came over to him<sup>asws</sup>, and he<sup>asws</sup>, in those days, was a boy. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘This one<sup>asws</sup> is your master<sup>asws</sup>, therefore attach yourselves to him<sup>asws</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 1. Ahmad ibn Mihran has narrated from Muhammad ibn Ali from ‘Abdallah al-Qalla’ from al-Fayd ibn al-Mukhtar who has said the following.

“I said to abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.), ‘Please, take my hand out of fire. Who is for us after you (leave this world)?” Then abu Ibrahim (Musa ibn Ja‘far (a.s.) came and he was a young boy in those days. The Imam (a.s.) said, “This is your companion hold fast to him.”
